data.title: 猫猫 · 海滨药草茶的苦味研究
data.description: 【海港药草市场·午后】猫猫穿着深绿色泳装外搭短披肩，坐在海边摊位前研究一杯冷泡药草茶；她尝过后皱眉，又加了一片柑橘，把调好的杯子推向镜头，蓝瞳里全是“这次可以了”的认真。
data.location: harbor herb market by the sea
data.action: 海港摊位试喝冷泡药草茶，调好苦味后把成品推向镜头
data.lighting: clear afternoon light on glass and green leaves
data.mood: 把假日也做成一场药理研究
data.promptProse: Maomao sits at the harbor herb stall in her deep-green swimsuit and short cream cape, studying chilled tea beside citrus peel and dried leaves. She frowns at the first taste, adds one citrus slice and pushes the improved glass toward the viewer with focused satisfaction. The horizontal medium view includes the herb pouch and stall counter. Clear afternoon light passes through glass and green leaves, leaving a citrus-colored reflection beneath her adjusting fingers.
